name: 020-chat-structured-json
description: Chat-completions request with response_format=json_object plus a JSON schema. Asserts the assistant's content parses as JSON and conforms to the supplied schema.

messages.content: Reply with a JSON object only. No prose.
Return an object with fields city (string), country (string), population (integer >= 0) for Paris, France.

ref_outputs.notes: `response_format: {"type": "json_object"}` is enforced at the token level (any JSON object). The `schema` key nested directly under a json_object response_format is not read by OpenAI-compatible servers, this one included, so the schema-match assertion holds only when the model follows the system prompt. 020-chat-guided-schema-keywords is the fixture for schema enforcement via `json_schema`.
